contexts.text: Laid it upon the shoulder () = with all their power.
Hand = power; arm, greater power; shoulder, all power. Illustrated.
Put it on her shoulder () = as much as it could receive. Shoulder = all power. AC 2832:11.
Her pitcher upon her shoulder () = receptions of truth, and endeavour. Shoulder = all power, thus endeavour.
Therefore shoulder is predicated of truth.
The shoulders = all power; thus the Lord's omnipotence.
To dwell between his shoulders () = ... everything of power; (which) good has through truth. ( = in security and in power. AE 449:10.)
Sometimes infernals present to view a shoulder, by phantasy, (causing) forces to be struck back... for they know that the shoulder corresponds to all power. Illustrated.
Borne upon the shoulder under darkness () = carried down among falsities with all power.
Incline his shoulder to bear () = labours with all exertion. Shoulder = all power, or all exertion.
Upon their shoulder () = according to all power.
The good which is the flesh there, is the thigh and the shoulder ().
With side and shoulder () = with all force and power. AE 316:19.
To fly on the shoulder of the Philistines. Explained. AE 433:7.
Two shoulders [i.e. shoulder pieces] joined together... () = the conservation of good and truth... with all exertion and power. Shoulders = all force and power.
That shoulders = all force and power in resisting, breaking, and acting. Illustrated.
That to place on the shoulders and carry = to preserve in a state of good and truth in perpetuity with all exertion and power. Illustrated.
Shoulders = things which support, because they support and carry.
Put them upon the shoulders of the ephod () = thus the support of Heaven and the conservation of good and truth there with all exertion and power. Explained.
Shoulders = power, and resistance. References.
A little dog on the shoulders. Explained.
The representation of a shoulder: magic.
The shoulders = power. AE 627:11.
The right shoulder, and the left shoulder of the house (). Explained.
The shoulder = the power or faculty of understanding truth.
Every shoulder () = all the power of truth.
